posts.name: Sayan Ghosh
posts.cooked:
There are two different conversations going on in this thread.

The original poster is trying to create file in /opt/ which is a shared folder and you do not have permissions to create files there. You are supposed to create the files in your home directory’s se2001 folder. Please follow the video showing the procedure of how to solve assignments in the VM.

The last two messages are talking about setting the executable permission on the script, which is also a required step to perform before running it.
